lines.en: Three hours later...
: I entered as a girl...but I emerge as a woman.
: I formally apologize for all of the things I did to you in that room. As your brother, I should know better.
: Apologize? Are you kidding? That was the best night of my life.
: Will I be paying for it in the morning? Probably. But that is a problem for tomorrow’s Noriko, when tonight’s Noriko is no longer dealing with the aftershock of over a hundred orgasms.
: Do you know what time it is by any chance?
: Like 3:30 last I checked?
: Want to go take a shower together? Because my body says “sleep,” but neither my mind nor the hotel staff will ever forgive me if I crawl into my futon drenched in sweat and brother juice.
: Onii-chan? Shower? We can go separately if you are sufficiently grossed out by me right now. Which you may be and I would not blame you for.
: Not that.
: Look down.
: Nee-chan?...
: Have you...been outside the door the whole time?
: Uhh...
: I’m...gonna let you handle this one.
: Yeah...
: Goodnight, Noriko. I’ll see you in the morning.
: Goodnight...Onii-chan. Onee-chan.
: Hah...
Where do I even begin?
At what point could I even start my explanation that wouldn’t cause her head to sink even further into her knees?
There isn’t one, is there?
I’ve really fucked up this time.
So much so that I don’t even know if I should be pivoting to damage control or just piling more pain onto her in an effort to tear her away from other doors in the future.
Because there will be more. And she was always going to find out one way or another.
I just didn’t expect her to subject herself to the same hurt I thrust upon her when it would have been infinitely easier to just...walk away and face me later.
She’s not like me, though.
She’s never been like me.
She doesn’t run. She doesn’t hide. And when something hurts or scares her, she does what any adult should do and just...confronts it.
I envy that. I envy her. I always will and I always have. But there’s a brief respite during times like this. For despite how much I am hurting, I can’t imagine it even compares to what she feels.
That’s always been her greatest weakness. That unwavering faith in me. The belief that I can be better if she just presses on and breaks through.
But everyone feels that way. And when everyone feels that way, what am I supposed to do?
It could have just as easily been Noriko in her sister’s place tonight. The same way it is with Ami every night now. And I can’t please everyone.
But that doesn’t stop me from trying. And failing. And winding up next to girls that I really do wish would just...go away.
Because for all she’s done for me...with me...
She’s the one I want to hurt the least.
But that just means I’m forced to hurt her the most.
And it might not make sense to you, but it’s what I’ve always done when it comes to her.
It’s all to protect her. From whatever I may do. From whatever fears may come.
She just...keeps coming back.
How much can this girl take?
: Five hours...
: You had sex with her for five hours.
: My sister...
: My little fucking sister who loves you with all her heart and has done nothing but look up to you her entire life...
: And you do that?
: The same things that were done to you?...That turned your life into a living hell?!
: Where did I go wrong?...
: What else could I have done?...
: There is nothing, Niki.
: There is nothing you could have done that would have changed this outcome.
: Then why did you let me try?!
: Because trying to stop you would just make you try even harder. That’s what you do.
: You’ve always wanted to fix me. But it’s wanting that that’s going to destroy you in the end.
: If this...isn’t the end right now.
: Are you breaking up with me then?...
: Shouldn’t I be the one asking you that question? Because it’d be hard to see you as anything but an idiot if you’re not. And I don’t want you to ruin my image of you.
: Guess you finally know about what was going on with Sekai then. Took you long enough.
: I’ve always known...
: I just didn’t want it to be real.
: And I don’t want this to be real either.
: I keep sitting here...with my eyes closed...hoping I’ll just...wake up and this will all be a part of some nightmare.
: But now my...knees are soaked from crying into them...my eyes hurt. And I’m hungry. And I just want this to be over.
: Why are you like this, Akira?...
: Why do you go out of your way to make things even worse for yourself?...
: I don’t understand...
: You’re not even supposed to be here...This weekend was for me! So I could do something to make my life better without you getting in the way again!
: And you fucking ruined it! Why didn’t you just stay at home?! That’s all you had to do!
: So you’d be happier just continuing to lead a life of delusion? Where you willfully ignore the things I’m doing behind the scenes?
: No, you fucking idiot! You’re over-complicating things again! I just wanted to bond with Ami and my sister!
: Not everything has to be some super deep and complex mental puzzle about you getting molested as a child! And yeah, that was horrible! But this world doesn’t revolve around you!
: Just let me have something! Anything! To distract me from the fact that I’ve wasted two thirds of my life on someone who will never love me as much as I love him!
: I’m sorry...
: No, you’re not! You’re just saying you are because it’s the easiest fucking way to roll over and submit to how fucking weak and stupid you are! Why won’t you just fight?!
: Do you have any idea how fucking annoying this is?! Being a fountain of fucking moral and mental support for you every day, just to watch you set yourself on fire?! Just to be ignored?!
: That’s why I ask if there’s something else I could have done...
: Something I could have changed that would have stopped you from perpetuating this fucking death spiral where you destroy the only meaningful connections you’ve ever had with anyone.
: Honestly, I think some people are just...destined to live terrible, hurtful lives.
: Honestly, I think you’re a fucking moron. That’s the dumbest thing I’ve ever heard.
: If it’s so dumb, then why has my life been nothing but endless torment from the moment I was born?
: Why has my life been nothing but endless torment from the moment I met you?
: Because you met me, obviously.
: Oh, good. At least you’re not a complete moron if you can acknowledge that then.
: You get what I’m saying though, right?
: What, that all of these years have been fucking wasted trying to convince someone who’s never known happiness that the concept itself isn’t a fucking myth?
: And here I thought that being a father would get you to wake the fuck up. Here I thought trying to show you what a real family felt like might finally change you.
: But Ami’s just as deranged as you are and now you’re fucking my sister too. So silly me, right? Silly fucking Niki for trying again! When all she wants to do is help!
: You and Noriko have that in common...that whole “wanting to help people” thing.
: Mhm! Want to know what else we have in common now too?
: You’re so fucking weak, Akira...so fucking weak.
: It’d be one thing if I just found weird shit on your computer...but actually sleeping with a girl her age?...
: I can’t watch what happened to you again...you were so fucking smart and precious. And Noriko’s so fucking smart too, but now she has to deal with this!
: And sure, she’s giddy and all like, “look at me, I’m a woman” now, but what if she looks back on this in five years and realizes how fucked up it was?
: You want to trash your connection to her too?! Someone who has rooted for you harder than anyone ever?!
: You were her fucking role model! You still are! So what if she turns around and does this same shit to someone else’s kid in the future?! What if you just created another monster?!
: Asking me the same questions I ask myself every day isn’t going to just magically help me come up with an answer.
: So she’s not the first then. And you’ve done this before.
: That’s right...
: How many times? With who? Because I assume now that’s what had that Maya girl storming out of the house when she found out I was living there. You fuck her too, Akira?
: Yes...I have.
: Pfft. Un-fucking-believable. Only you could have someone like me begging to be your one-and-only just to turn around and fuck some random high schooler.
: My parents should’ve called the cops on that fucking tutor of yours long before she died. But I told them everything was fine. Because I believed you.
: I have always believed you. Always just let you do your thing because I had enough faith in you to think you’d be able to fix things on your own. How fucking dumb I was.
: You weren’t dumb, Niki...You were a kid.
: Yeah, and so were you. But while I was in bed watching Pokemon and painting my nails, you were in bed with a grown woman, learning everything about life except what’s important.
: It wasn’t like that, Niki. She loved me. She really loved me.
: Yeah, and I’m sure you think you really love Noriko too, don’t you?
: Because I do.
: So what then? It’s okay to fuck whoever you want regardless of their age so long as you convince yourself you love them? Is that the message you’re trying to send me here?
: Niki, there’s only one message I’m trying to send you right now and it’s the same one you’re trying to send me. That I’m irredeemable and you’re an idiot for still caring this much.
: But why are you irredeemable?...And how can you not blame that woman for what you’ve turned into? Without her, it would’ve just been you and me. Forever.
: I don’t...know what I’d be without her, though. Because I barely existed before her.
: You existed. You had interests and hobbies and foods that you liked. But her being nicer to you than your mom or your brother doesn’t mean she gave you life.
: I was nice to you too, Akira. I opened myself up to you in a way I’ve never done with anyone else.
: And now I finally have to face the fact that the entire time we were together, you were with someone else. Someone who probably made me look like a worthless amateur by comparison.
: Is that why you left when she died? Started hunting? Because I wasn’t good enough? Couldn’t give you what you really wanted? Artificial love instead of the real kind?
: I don’t know what I was doing back then...I was just...
: I acted on instinct after she died. And my instinct was to leave you behind.
: But why?! Why am I your punching bag?! That can’t be why I was put here, Akira! I’m more than that! Better than that!
: I imagine I thought the same thing back then that I do now...that if I hurt you badly enough, you’ll stop subjecting yourself to this.
: You and Noriko weren’t supposed to find me again. You guys were supposed to move on...
: But here you are, years later, still wrapped up in the same shit that kept me up at night back then. Just now, I’m on the opposite end of things.
: But the two of you are exactly where you’ve always been — caught in the middle of my bullshit and trying to jump in front of the gun I aim at myself in exchange for...nothing.
: You two love me so much...but I have never given you anything. I don’t get it.
: You don’t get it because love is more than just an exchange, idiot!
: I don’t want to love you! I don’t want to try and be a mom to a creepy red-head in my twenties! I want to focus on myself and my career!
: I want to help other girls learn how to sing! I want to start a fashion line and do makeup ads and be on billboards and go to fancy beach inns and get paid lots of money!
: I want people to pamper me and tell me I’m great! That I’m pretty! That all those years of hard work were not wasted! But every second I’m with you, I feel like they were!
: I could conquer the world before making you happy...and I just don’t understand that. Because the logic would dictate here that if I hadn’t gotten through yet, that you just...don’t like me.
: But you do. And I wish that you didn’t because it would make all of this so much easier.
: That was my sister, Akira...
: You didn’t cheat on me with just anybody. It wasn’t just any teenager. It was my sister.
: Can there be a greater betrayal than this?...What am I supposed to do now? Just...get over it?! Accept that you’re a fucking pig and just...move on?!
: Just...leave...
: You think I don’t want to?! You think I can walk into a room, see that and think, “Haha! Typical Akira! Hey, everyone! Look at how sad he is! Feel bad for him!” No, moron!
: I want to fucking kill you right now! I’m so mad that it is taking every ounce of self-restraint in my body to not just strangle you to death!
: But you’re not doing that...because you made a promise to me.
: Because you asked me to make a promise to you...
: You looked at me, more terrified and helpless than I have ever seen you, and you asked me if I’d really never leave you.
: It’s the only time you have ever asked me for help...and it proved to me that you want me by your side.
: That’s why I took you home that night. And do you remember what happened next?
: Of course I remember what happened next...
: I waited over a decade for that moment. And I thought to myself once we were done that things were going to start getting better.
: That you’d open up to me more. That you knew you didn’t need to keep secrets from me...and that I wouldn’t judge you for telling me them.
: We both know that’s a lie, though. You were always going to judge me when you found out about this.
: Maybe. Probably! Because it’s fucking horrible! But that doesn’t mean you should just do it in front of me!
: Yeah, that...
: I probably...should have stopped when you walked in.
: You think?
: I’m sorry, Niki...that I’ve done nothing but hurt you. I can promise you that’s the exact opposite of what I-
: Your promises mean literally nothing to me, Akira. They’re worthless. So worthless that you can’t even look me in the eye when you make them.
: I’m ashamed...
: Good. You should be ashamed. But what does that mean for me? What do I do now?
: Because being there for you doesn’t work. Not being there for you doesn’t work.
: Do you want me to castrate you? Because I will. And I am very tempted to do that right now.
: I’m often tempted to do that myself...Figure it would shave at least 50%% of my problems off.
: I’m a coward as always, though. I can’t follow through with it. Imagine it would probably be easier to just kill myself if anything.
: You’re an asshole, but...
: I don’t...think you need to go that far.
: Can you just...
: Chain me up or something, please?
: Is the...temptation really that bad? I don’t get it...
: I don’t either...but I want it to stop just as badly as you want to stop having feelings for me.
: I just...keep going, though. I keep doing it. Even when I know it isn’t good for anyone.
: I just can’t stop myself, Niki...I cave every single time.
: Akira...
: I can’t help you this time.
: Or even...try to since you never accept my help in the first place.
: It’s just...
: This has gone way too far.
: And I think that...
: Well...
: Maybe some...time apart will...
: Help me figure out what I...want to do about...all of this.
: Because I love you, but...
: You make it...very hard for me to just...exist sometimes.
: And not having to worry about me...waking up beside you...how you’ll hurt me next...
: Maybe that’ll be good for you too...
: I take it you’re moving out then?...
: I have a...lot of work coming up soon.
: And I didn’t want to say anything about it until I was 100%% sure, but...
: This next album...is going to be my last.
: So there’s a lot of recording and practice and promo stuff that needs to be done, and I-
: You’re quitting?...
: Niki-
: Akira, I’m almost 30. It’s a miracle people still want to see me in a swimsuit at this point.
: That’s nothing, though. That’s-
: It is in the idol world. And besides, with how...drastically my life has changed since you came back into it, I don’t...really think I’m in the right head-space to keep going.
: I started doing this to get back at you, remember? And yeah...I love my job. I love sharing my songs with everyone. But nothing...
: Nothing comes out...right now that we’ve been reunited. And, no offense, but most of the stuff that’s happened since we have has...kinda sucked.
: And I don’t want that to negatively impact an otherwise...nearly flawless career, so...I figure if I go out with a bang...I can sort of just...well...
: My mark’s been made already...
: And there’s not much more I can do here, I don’t think...
: That’s...another reason I wanted to move in with you.
: I figured that...once my career was over...I’d have a lot more time for you and Ami and...
: And we could figure out a way to make this work...
: But now you don’t know...and I’ll have destroyed your career for nothing.
: I just need time, okay?...
: So I’m not moving out. I’ll just...be in hotels a little more than normal and...sleep on the couch whenever I’m not.
: And if you...do need help with anything, I will still be there. I just...
: Maybe we should...just be friends again...
: For a little while...
: Akira?...
: That’s okay...right?
: You do...whatever it is you need to do. For yourself.
: For your art.
Niki’s affection has decreased by 50!
